statement: For four general real lines in P³, the attainable numbers of distinct real common transversals are exactly {0,2}. A single real solution occurs only on the branch locus, with multiplicity two, and is excluded from this regular-fibre spectrum.

source.location: Section 1, four-lines argument and Figure 1, printed p. 3; real quadratic-intersection consequence

scope: Four ordered real lines in P³ on the regular pairwise-skew locus; count distinct real common transversals.
notes: Derived from the real quadratic restriction Q|l_4 in the cited geometric construction. Positive and negative discriminant give the two attained counts. Complex conjugation and degree 2 exclude any other regular count.
